title: Live-Service Uplift for Late Recovery Resets (Web Hosting Plans and Domain Registrations)
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

**Clause.** The live-service uplift of the late-reset goodwill follows the products the customer held while the reset was outstanding: where the customer holds an active hosting plan on Web Hosting Plans, the uplift is $4.00; where the customer holds no active hosting plan but holds an active domain on Domain Registrations, the uplift is $2.00; otherwise no uplift is added. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-reset goodwill figure.

**Points of judgement.** An active hosting plan alone decides the higher amount, whether or not an active domain is also held; the two amounts are never both added. A domain in grace or redemption is not an active domain.
